questions.name: If a number is divided by 5, remainder = 2. If the same number is divided by 7, remainder = 3. What is the smallest such number?
questions.nameText:
If
 a number is divided by 5, remainder = 2. If the same number is
 divided by 7, remainder = 3. What is the smallest such number?

options.name: 17
23
38
52

questions.solution:
Number = 5k + 2. Check divisibility by 7.

k=6 → 5(6)+2=32 remainder 4.

k=7 → 37 remainder 2.

k=8 → 42 remainder 0.

k=9 → 47 remainder 5.

k=10 → 52 remainder 3 .

So number = 52 .

questions.name: The probability of getting a sum of 9 when two dice are thrown is:
questions.nameText:
The
 probability of getting a sum of 9 when two dice are thrown is:

options.name: 1/12
1/9
5/39
7/36

questions.solution:
Combinations: (3,6), (4,5), (5,4), (6,3).

Total = 4 outcomes.

Probability = 4/36 = 1/9 (Correction → 1/9, not 1/12).

questions.name: The sum of present ages of A and B is 60. 5 years ago, A was 5 times B. What are their ages?
questions.nameText:
The
 sum of present ages of A and B is 60. 5 years ago, A was 5 times
 B. What are their ages?

options.name: A=55, B=5
A=50, B=10
A=45, B=15
A=40, B=20

questions.solution:
A+B=60.

(A–5) = 5(B–5).

Solving → A=50, B=10.

questions.name: A can complete a work in 20 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. In how many days will B finish the same work?
questions.nameText:
A
 can complete a work in 20 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. In
 how many days will B finish the same work?

options.name: 15
16
18
20

questions.solution:
A’s 1-day work = 1/20.

Efficiency of B = 125% of A = 5/4 × (1/20) = 1/16.

So B will finish in 16 days.

questions.name: A shopkeeper allows 20% discount on the marked price and still makes 25% profit. If the marked price is ₹1000, what is the cost price?
questions.nameText:
A
 shopkeeper allows 20% discount on the marked price and still makes
 25% profit. If the marked price is ₹1000, what is the cost
 price?

options.name: ₹600
₹625
₹650
₹700

questions.solution:
SP = 1000 – 20% of 1000 = 800.

Profit = 25%.

CP = 800 / 1.25 = 640 (correction, not 600).

 than B from the profit. Find the total profit.

options.name: ₹3600
₹4000
₹4200
₹4800

questions.solution:
Difference = 1 part.

1 part = 400.

Total = 9 parts = 9×400=3600.

questions.name: A sum of ₹10,000 is invested at 20% per annum compounded annually. What will be the compound interest after 2 years?
questions.nameText:
A
 sum of ₹10,000 is invested at 20% per annum compounded
 annually. What will be the compound interest after 2 years?

options.name: ₹4000
₹4200
₹4400
₹4800

questions.solution:
CI = P[(1 + r/100)^t – 1] = 10000[(1.2)^2 – 1] = 10000(1.44 – 1) = 4400.

(Answer : ₹4400).

questions.name: Two trains of lengths 120m and 180m are running in opposite directions with speeds 60 km/h and 90 km/h. In how much time will they cross each other?
questions.nameText:
Two
 trains of lengths 120m and 180m are running in opposite directions
 with speeds 60 km/h and 90 km/h. In how much time will they cross
 each other?

options.name: 6 sec
8 sec
10 sec
12 sec

questions.solution:
Relative speed = (60+90)×(5/18)=41.67 m/s.

Total length = 300m.

Time = 300/41.67 ≈ 10 sec.

 to a boy, Seema said, “He is the son of my grandfather’s
 only son.” How is the boy related to Seema?

options.name: Brother
Cousin
Uncle
Nephew

questions.solution: Grandfather’s only son = Seema’s father. Boy = son of Seema’s father → brother.

questions.name: In a row of 40 students, A is 12th from the left and B is 18th from the right. How many students are between A and B?

In
 a row of 40 students, A is 12th from the left and B is 18th from
 the right. How many students are between A and B?

options.name: 8
9
10
11

questions.solution:
A = 12th from left. B = 23rd from left (40–18+1).

Between = 23–12–1 = 10.

 ‘A × B’ means A is the father of B, ‘A +

 means A is the mother of B, then P – Q × R means?

options.name: P is mother of R

questions.solution: Q × R → Q father of R. P – Q → P mother of Q → So P mother of R.
